response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile software engineer with deep full-stack, TypeScript/Node.js, and D-language experience, but the resume shows no C-for-UNIX systems experience, no Linux kernel investigation/modification work, no embedded firmware or LAN-switch background, and none of the required security/networking technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, SNMP, NETCONF, switch chips). Critically, there is no evidence of native or working Japanese proficiency, which is a hard requirement, making this role a poor fit despite his overall engineering caliber.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, high-quality software engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded-adjacent domains
Some low-level C/C++ experience (NI LabWindows/CVI, DLang low-latency systems)
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, lead technical initiatives, and communicate (talks, workshops, open source)
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, a mandatory requirement for this role
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded firmware experience
No exposure to required security/networking domains (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF, switch chip knowledge)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded firmware experience
No security/networking domain expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, etc.)
